chunks: And with this chain, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Be concerned with olive oil; eat it and anoint yourselves with it, for whoever eats it and anoints himself with it, Satan will not approach him for forty days.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of consuming olive oil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Prophetic emphasis on olive oil as a comprehensive remedy, linking its consumption and topical application to spiritual protection from Satan for forty days. In Shia tradition, this reflects the holistic view of the body and soul, where physical purity and nourishment serve as a shield against spiritual impurities, a concept often associated with the medicinal virtues of the Prophet's family (Ahl al-Bayt).
